content:
Jaz: FYI my ISP pushed a surprise maintenance and took my wired run offline. ended up building a tiny "portable network greenhouse" to hide a new ethernet run. photo: https://i.imgur.com/greenhouse123.jpg
Asha: 😂😂 no way. pic or it didn't happen :seedling:
Tom: omg that looks like a terrarium for routers. brilliant and weird.
Jaz: uploaded — it's basically a clear tote, a fake ficus, and a discreet grommet at the base. used adhesive cable clips + weatherproof tape. no plants harmed.
Lina: can you share the quick parts list? moving near a window and need ideas.
Jaz: sure — spare 5m Cat6, small unmanaged switch, USB-C power brick, zip-ties, adhesive grommet, clear tote, fake plant. diagram: `laptop -> usb-c modem -> switch -> cat6 (grommet) -> room`.
Marcus: did you ground the thing or just embrace chaos? :joy:
Jaz: embraced chaos. tested for hum, all good. humidity was my worry so I put a small silica pack in the tote.
Asha: protip: label both ends. once you hide it in foliage you will forget.
Tom: vote: is this "plant tech" or "excessive home improvement"? react :one: plant-tech or :two: excessive
Lina: :one: definitely plant-tech.
Marcus: :two: but only because I'm jealous.
maintenance-bot: Reminder: ISP maintenance window tonight 02:00–03:00 UTC — expect intermittent connectivity in some zones.
Jaz: perfect timing 😅 thanks for the reminder @maintenance-bot
Asha: also — if you keep electronics in closed containers consider small desiccant + occasional airing. learned that the hard way.
Tom: also if you ever want a legit long run I have an SFP and 20m fiber we can loan.
Jaz: @Tom you're a godsend, will take you up on that if the landlord gets suspicious. :pray:
Lina: now obsessed. posting my shelf-of-cables tour tomorrow morning. who wants to trade decor tips? :camera_flash:
Asha: me. bet mine has more stickers.
Marcus: i'll bring snack-based incentives for tours.
Jaz: thanks all — appreciate the tips and the laugh. will update if the greenhouse survives the rain.
Tom: (reacted :thumbsup: to Jaz)
Asha: (reacted :heart: to photo)
